rationale: parse_design_ir_json now bounds-checks DesignIR bytes before the CHOC JSON parser (unterminated strings and escapes, unbalanced or over-deep nesting, embedded NUL) and throws DesignIrParseError; pulp-design-ir-observe and pulp-ui-frames-observe report it and exit 1 instead of dying by SIGBUS/SIGABRT. Generic DesignIR reader hardening landed in Pulp per the 2026-10-04 temporary ownership exception; Vellum inherits it. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves. Same change also confines a document-loaded asset's local_path and file:// original_uri to the document directory (after resolving symlinks) unless the file hashes to the declared sha256, logging a refusal instead of painting an arbitrary host file.
